summary: Liberty Energy Inc. filed a Form 8-K (Items 1.01, 9.01) to add disclosure on a previously reported equipment supply contract between subsidiary Liberty Advanced Equipment Technologies LLC and Northeast-Western Energy Systems USA LLC, dated February 13, 2026, for power generation equipment supporting distributed power and prospective data center projects. The NES-WES contract price is approximately $493.2 million, inclusive of tariffs and transportation, adjustable to actual costs at final payment; Amendment No. 1, dated May 27, 2026, revised milestone invoice and payment events. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation.
